name: householdbot
description: Runs a household's paperwork from a conversation: files letters, bills, contracts and policies into one record the household owns, tracks deadlines, renewals and cancel-by dates with the country's holidays, and briefs you on the week ahead. Works in English or Polish, from photos, PDFs and pasted messages; connectors are optional. Nothing is written, sent or paid without your approval.

interface.shortDescription: Household paperwork, bills and deadlines, with your approval
interface.longDescription: HouseholdBot files letters, bills, contracts and policies in a folder the household owns, tracks every deadline with its legal basis and weekday, drafts replies, appeals and cancellations, and sums up the week. English and Polish; country rules for Poland and for England and Wales. Nothing is written, sent, signed or paid without a household member's yes.
